directCertifications.certificateIdentifier: Studio O+A Studio O+A is an internationally celebrated design firm that specializes in holistically designed environments. Our services include every aspect of interior architecture and brand strategy, including space planning, concept development, environmental graphics, brand building, signage and wayfinding, furniture coordination, and construction oversight. We work with our clients to create spaces that reflect their values and tell their story while providing custom solutions for every function of their business. Studio O+A also produces experimental and pro-bono projects that focus on the future of work, wellness, community outreach and sustainable design. From this mix of projects, commercial and experimental, we have developed a practice that prioritizes diversity, climate awareness, healthy work habits, and built environments designed with the future in mind. Studio O+A is honored to be recognized by the Cooper Hewitt, IIDA, ASID, ADC for their body of work. Certified since October 2022
